🏷️ The sneaky sign

"NOW ONLY £60 after 25% off!" Your mate says the old price was £60 + 25% = £75.

What was the real price before the sale?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

£60 is what is LEFT

75% = £60

Step 2

25% = £20

100% = 4 × £20 = £80

£80, not £75. Your mate owes you a coffee! 🏷️

🔐 Crack the safe

Work out each one. Each answer is one number of the code. Chat first, then click!

1

After 50% off it costs £38. Original?

🔒

76

2

25% of a number is 8. The number?

🔒

32

3

🔒

50

110% = £55, 10% = £5

🔓 The code is 76 · 32 · 50 – the safe is OPEN! 💰
